phone.scanQr: Scan the QR code on the big screen to join the game.
phone.pickEdge: Tap the edge of the tile that should touch the map, or use All positions.
phone.pickSpot: Pick the number of a position.
phone.noSpots: The tile cannot be placed with that edge connected.
phone.pickFeature: Tap the part of the tile where the figure should stand.
phone.exchangeHint: None of your tiles fit anywhere. Swap one for a new tile.
phone.padHint: Touchpad: drag to move the map, pinch to zoom, twist to rotate, tap to select an area.
phone.pickTile: Tap the tile you want to play.
rules.title: Rules
phone.statsOnScreen: The statistics are shown on the big screen.
start.unreadable: Cannot be read (saved by another version)
help.phase.chooseTile: Choose which of your tiles to play. If none of them can be placed anywhere, you may swap one for a new tile from the stack.
help.phase.placeTile: Place the tile. Tap the edge of the tile that should touch the map, then the number of a position. You can also pick All positions. The tile must fit its neighbours on every side.
help.phase.placeFigure: You may place one figure on the tile you just placed, on a part that no one else already has a figure in. Tap the part, then the figure. You may also skip it.
help.phase.confirm: Check your move. Tap Confirm move to finish your turn, or Undo to go back one step.
help.phase.other: Follow the choices shown on your phone. Undo takes back the last step, and nothing is final until you confirm the move.
help.expansion.river: The River: the river tiles are laid first, and each new river tile must continue the river without turning back on itself. Until the lake is placed, players only hold river tiles.
help.expansion.abbot: The Abbot: instead of a normal figure you may place your abbot on a garden or a monastery, or take your abbot back from the board to score its points.
help.expansion.inns-cathedrals: Inns & Cathedrals: a completed road with an inn scores 2 points per tile, and a completed city with a cathedral 3 per tile and pennant, but both score nothing if unfinished at the end. The large follower counts as two followers when deciding who wins a feature, but does not double the points.
help.expansion.traders-builders: Traders & Builders: whoever completes a city takes its trade goods. At the end, most of each good scores 10 points (ties all score 10). Your builder joins a road or city where you have a follower; extending it lets you take an extra turn if you want it. Your pig joins a field where you have a farmer and makes it score 4 instead of 3 per completed city.
help.expansion.gold-mines: The Gold Mines: when you place a tile with a gold symbol, one gold bar goes on it and one on a neighbouring tile you choose (diagonals count). When a feature is scored, the gold on its tiles goes to the players who score it, one bar at a time starting with the player whose turn it is; each player picks which bar to take. At the end each bar is worth 1 point for 1-3 bars, 2 for 4-6, 3 for 7-9 and 4 for 10 or more.
help.expansion.mage-witch: Mage & Witch: when you place a tile with a magic symbol, or a tile or ferry that joins the mage's and the witch's roads, you must move the mage or the witch to an unfinished road or city. The mage gives +1 point per tile when that feature is scored; the witch halves the score, rounded up.
help.phase.gold: Choose a neighbouring tile (diagonals count) for the second gold bar. Then you may place a figure as usual.
help.phase.gold-pick: Gold is handed out one bar at a time, clockwise from the player whose turn it is. Pick the number of the tile whose gold bar you want to take. If all the bars you may take lie on one tile, you get one automatically.
help.phase.tb-extra: Your builder gave you an extra turn. Take it to draw another tile and play a second part of your turn, or skip it. The choice is yours.
help.phase.mage-witch: Move the mage or the witch to an unfinished road or city: pick a number. If there is nowhere to go, remove one of them from the board.
help.expansion.ferries: The Ferries: after you place a lake tile (and your figure), place a ferry linking two of its road ends into one road. When your tile extends a road that has a ferry, you may move the first ferry on that road to link another pair of road ends on its lake. Each ferry moves at most once per turn (a builder's double turn counts as one turn).
help.phase.ferries-place: Choose which two road ends of the lake tile the ferry links.
help.phase.ferries-move: You may move a ferry: tap its number, then choose which road ends it should link. Tap Done when you do not want to move more.
help.expansion.flying-machines: The Flying Machines: when you place a tile with a flying machine, you may let a follower fly instead of placing it normally. The die (1-3) decides how many tiles it flies in the direction of the machine; it lands on an unfinished road, city or cloister there, even an occupied one. If it cannot land, it returns to your supply. Once the die is rolled you cannot undo the move.
help.phase.flying-machines: Pick the number of the road, city or cloister where your follower lands.
help.phase.crop-circles-2: A crop circle was placed. First the player whose turn it is chooses: everyone adds a follower or everyone removes one, on a city, road or field of the circle's kind. Then each player in turn chooses where. If you cannot, you are skipped.
help.expansion.crop-circles-2: Crop Circles II: when a tile with a crop circle (city, road or field) is placed, all players either add a follower next to one of their own, or all remove one, in a feature of the circle's kind.
help.expansion.princess-dragon: The Princess & the Dragon: a volcano tile moves the dragon onto it, and nobody may place a figure there. A dragon tile makes the dragon move 6 tiles, one per player in turn, never revisiting a tile or entering the fairy's tile; it eats every figure on the tiles it enters. A magic portal lets you place a follower on any free, unfinished feature. A princess tile that extends a city may remove a knight there instead of placing a follower. Instead of placing a follower you may move the fairy next to one of your followers: she protects it from the dragon, gives you 1 point at the start of your turn and 3 more when its feature scores.
help.phase.dragon: Move the dragon one tile: pick a number. Players take turns until it has moved six tiles. It cannot return to a tile it already visited or enter the fairy's tile.
help.phase.portal: Pick the number of a free, unfinished feature anywhere on the map for your follower.
